[[Sapphire]]s | pvpreward = Exotic }} The [[Amethyst Aegis]] is a rare type of [[shield]]. The body of the shield appears to be made entirely of one giant, cut, crystal of [[wikipedia:Amethyst|amethyst]], the facets of which appear to sparkle when it is rotated. This is capped with decorative golden metal at the corners of the shield and at the center of the front of the shield. ==Acquisition== '''[[Core]]''' *[[Isle of the Nameless]] **[[Zaishen Chest]] *[[The Fissure of Woe]] **[[Chest of Woe]] *[[The Underworld]] **[[Underworld Chest]] '''[[Eye of the North]]''' *[[Depths of Tyria]] **[[Slavers' Exile]] ***[[Chest of the Slaver (Forgewight)]] ***[[Chest of the Slaver (Justiciar Thommis)]] ***[[Chest of the Slaver (Rand Stormweaver)]] ***[[Hierophant's Chest]] ''Drop research is ongoing and can be found [[Talk:Amethyst Aegis#Drop research|here]].'' ==Dye== [[Dye]] affects the entire shield except the golden metallic regions. The crystal is tinted depending on the dye color specified. It will dye to an inverse of the color applied (with the exception of silver, white and black dyes) but this will only show in only some facets of the crystal - which facets appear tinted depends on the viewing angle; some facets will always retain their magenta coloring at any given viewing angle. Although the golden metallic cornices are not affected by dye, they are shown to be affected on the inventory icon. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye. {{dye chart}} ==Notes== Other shields with this appearance: *{{w}} [[Shield of the Hierophant]] ([[Unique item|unique]]) * To buy it as [[PvP reward]] red item, you have to unlock the [[PvP_reward#Exotic_Weapon|Exotic Weapon]] tab via [[Tolkano]] and pay '''18''' [[Tournament Reward Points]] or '''20''' [[Silver Zaishen Coin]] to create this specific skin.
